notes: Session Heat is global H1-H4 only; intensity-5 cards are pair-specific unlocks.
matchRequired=true cards require an existing session MATCH for that pair.
signalEffects may contain multiple effects. mutual-match creates MATCH; one-off-mutual never creates a persistent MATCH.
All cards remain skippable even when consentMode is not skip-anytime.
For never_have_i, Shared Signal counts only positive 做过 responses and excludes >=80% positive consensus.
For either_or, Compatibility excludes >=80% consensus, skipped answers, and requires at least 3 informative co-answers.
